text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—Hm, a DM... ..."Request for beat 
production", huh.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(These pop up ev~ery once in a while. Sent 
to "!monad", the alias I post tracks 
under.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Making tracks is just something to keep 
my hands busy during analysis, a way to 
reset my brain... Nothing more than a 
pastime you can barely even call a hobby. 
I've got zero intention of making tracks 
for someone else. This one's also—)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Another one came in... "!monad, 
please produce it with complete freedom. I 
want to lay my lyrics over your sound."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Complete freedom, huh... It's not an 
angle to get it done for free or on the 
cheap. ...They're saying they specifically 
want "me"?)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ............That's completely illogical.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(—That said... I've never made a track 
with the premise of rap being laid over 
it. I can't picture a sinnnngle thing...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Should I just tweak one of my stock 
tracks to sound "hip-hop-ish" and call it 
a day? It'd turn out decent enough. 
But...)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um, Shakur-san... It's almost lights-out, 
thoughhh...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'll turn 'em off. 'Night.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(...Wait, Shakur-san isn't sleeping after 
allll... She's been on her PC this whole 
time... listening to music?)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(It was like this after that race the 
other day, too. Back then, Shakur-san 
was... ...Is she troubled about something 
today too, I wondell...)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...Is there anything I can do, I wonderrr?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking through the academy 
grounds—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—Even so... of all the people to ask, why 
the hell did you call out to *her*?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
B-But, out of everyone I know, when 
thinking about the person who knows the 
most about musiccc...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! That means it is time for me, TM 
Opera O, to take the stage!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Is there any wonderful music that could 
help Shakur-san unwind?" ...When Doto 
asked, the answer was right before her 
eyes!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, Shakur-san! Make your choice! Will it 
be Doto's emotional Hip-hop Enka, or my 
fabulous Hip-hop Opera?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? The hell is that?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I heard that you are fond of hip-hop! So 
Doto and I agreed that we ought to arrange 
it for you!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I'll do my best to rhyme toooo...! So, 
please, Shakur-san...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hey, you. Trainer over there. You decide.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You were staring blankly at us anyway. 
Pick whichever one you want. I sure as 
hell don't wanna choose...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! But of course you would! 
Entitled... "My Beloved Rhyme"! Let us 
begin!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
My name is Opera O! The greatest horse 
girl, the supreme horse girl!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...The hell?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Opera O, scented of roses, Hmm, so sweet 
and fragrant, la la la~♪ All spectators, 
sing my praises! Hands up!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
—With that, the curtain falls on Hip-hop 
Opera! ...Temptation! O sole mioooo!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...No, how the hell was that "Hip-hop 
Opera"? There wasn't a trace of either 
element in there.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I rhymed at the very end, did I not? Above 
all, whenever I perform, everything 
becomes opera! Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: That definition is sloppy as hell—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, well... I guess that's true. If 
I'm the one making it... it'll all become 
mine anyway. Then, literally just do it 
freely...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
My, it seems I have imparted wisdom upon 
the sage Shakur-san! As expected of me... 
what a sinful genius I am!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Doto. I'll treat you to a meal 
sometime. Bring that one along too. With 
duct tape over her mouth, though.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...! Yes, Shakur-san...! ...Huh, duct 
tape?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Doto. Just sayin', but don't push 
yourself. You're gonna crash and burn.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
B-But... I... want to do my best! MC Doto, 
here I gooo...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...Y-Yo-oo~♪ Pedal to the metal, my rhymes 
on the gas, full throotleee~♪ Haaahn~♪

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uhh~♪ Ah, ice cream~, v-violets~... 
frogs~...♪ Hmm hmm hmm-hmm~...♪

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...! Hey, that melody just now...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Um... Shakur-san, your headphones leak 
sound sometimes... So I looked up the 
tracks based on that... I-I'm sorry!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
But I thought, if I could talk to you 
about things you like, maybe it would help 
you relax a little, Shakur-san...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Doto...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Hearing an absurd enka like that really 
makes you drop your guard and sigh. And 
cleared up whatever was clogging my head 
while at it.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...! Sh-Shakur-saaan~!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
So Shakur-san was feeling troubled! In 
that case, let me grant you inspiration as 
well! Feast your ears on "The Triumphant 
Return of Opera O"!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I seriously don't need that.
